potd: No steals / blocks: see the official standards and rule 4. No POTD (or POTD backup / Today POTD) whose stat includes steals or blocks, pure or combo. [AMENDED 2026-10-31 4:46 PM ET: the steals/blocks ban applies ONLY to basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, any basketball league), pure or combo. NHL blocked shots and every non-basketball sport are ALLOWED.]
GAME DAY PROCESS applies: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.
Volume potd: one POTD per sport bubble when that sport has games. Hard Rock price -105 to -135 at selection. No edge requirement (POTD and POTD #n).

Filters: the Alt Line Parlay volume filter and eligible-player rules and bans, plus hit rate at that exact line of at least 7 of last 10, with 8+ of last 10 preferred (the only hit-rate test). NASCAR (Q-NAS4,): the model must also agree (H2H: lower expected finish; Top N: expected finish <= N), a required filter on top of 7+/10; markets and hit-rate definitions in.
The card carries a "Volume" stamp. The Majors/Today POTD is the best of the Big 4 sport POTDs (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB).

Potd status: A POTD held the official standards is never shown as 'No qualifying ticket today'. the bot today.potd_status/potd_status_text say it is on hold (LineMate missing / rescan in progress / posts at 11 AM). 'No qualifying ticket today' only when LineMate was present or restored and nothing met the standards. [auditfix1108: user-approved 2026-11-08, card answer "Yes, add both rulebook changes"]
Price drift: a POTD only has to be in band at selection. Later moves of any size never void it. Void only for inactive player or postponed/cancelled game.
A provisional pick that is out of band before lock with no in-band replacement is marked "On hold" and re-checked at lock. It still never voids for drift.

POTD auto-chain: when a sport's POTD settles, a staged pick posts as "POTD #n" (official, locked). Candidates meet the same filters, are pregame with at least 10 min to start, use no game already used by the chain, are in band, and pass a final live Hard Rock check. Nothing qualifies, nothing posts. All Sports POTD does NOT chain. The newest chain pick shows alone in the card.
Every POTD locks when posted at the 7 AM ET publish. A POTD player ruled out before his game is swapped or voided per.
parlay100: DISPLAY AMENDMENT — user-approved 2026-11-06 6:39 PM ET, t491u (clarifies t488u): rename the existing Official "+100" to exactly "+100", including chain #n, tabs, cards, Today, Results/Record and alerts. Display-only: rules, source ledgers, record history, Official status and internal keys/categories stay unchanged. Canonical the bot source heads remain - +100: and - +100 #n:; these are parser keys, not display labels. Main or alt real Hard Rock lines remain allowed under the existing checks. Today's three existing tickets retain their legs, prices and records.
Game day process applies to every leg: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.

Volume parlay: 2-3 legs. Legs may be ANY real Hard Rock line: a player prop OR a game line (spread, total, moneyline, team total), main or alt, at any price (no per-leg range) down to the -500 code floor below. No edge requirement. The eligible-prop list does not limit +100 legs.

Filters: player-prop legs pass the volume/role filter and bans and hit that exact line in 7+ of the player's last 10. Game-line legs need the team/game to have hit that line in 7+ of its last 10. 7+ of last 10 is the only hit-rate test. NASCAR (Q-NAS4,): legs also need the model to agree, a required filter on top of 7+/10.

Chain [AMENDED 2026-11-10 by builder1110 from 2026-11-11: #2 chain legs are chosen while combining, and each +100 holds at most one 3PM leg]: a parlay that settles (L as soon as any leg loses) is followed by "+100 #n" built to the same rules, combined +100 to +140, using no game from an earlier parlay that day. The All Sports (Big 4) parlay chains too.
Same-game rule: legs normally come from different games. When only ONE game is on the slate or left, the ticket is built as a same-game parlay PREGAME.
All Sports parlay: safest 2-4 legs, about +100 to +115. Official. Must use different legs and cannot be a pure copy of a sport parlay.
edge: No steals / blocks: see the official standards and rule 4. The bot never builds a steals/blocks prop (pure or combo); any that slips through is dropped, NO FILL. [AMENDED 2026-10-31 4:46 PM ET: the steals/blocks ban applies ONLY to basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, any basketball league), pure or combo. NHL blocked shots and every non-basketball sport are ALLOWED.]

Hard Rock price vs Pinnacle no-vig fair. Edge % = EV% at Hard Rock price. Ranked by edge % [AMENDED 2026-11-05 8:38 AM ET, NHL EDGE FILTER below: NHL Edge ranks goal overs and SOG unders first (market priority tier), then by edge %; then at most 3 NHL assist overs per night and at most 3 NHL Edge plays per game; singles only, flat 1u]. Each pick is locked once posted.
NHL EDGE FILTER; from the Nov 5 slate; NHL Edge only):
Applies in both NHL sport Edge and Big 4 Edge. SOG unders, assist unders, and non-gated markets stay untouched.
Pre-game L10 skater & L5 starter gates:

20-95m pre-game re-check: for posted Pending NHL Edge plus-money overs on unstarted games, voids pre-game (Void: pre-game NHL Edge filter (...), counted as Void / 0u via lock_check.edge_countable, mirrored to the bot and the bot) if the confirmed/projected DailyFaceoff starter has L5 SV% >=.900 or live Pinnacle two-way pricing drops live edge at the posted Hard Rock price below 4.0% or moves fair probability > 1.5 percentage points against the over.
ONE PASS, NO FILLER: Edge runs one pass and posts only plays that qualify. Nothing is filled. This supersedes COUNT's "at least 3" and ALWAYS FILL below.
Qualifying threshold: positive EV at the Hard Rock price, about -130 or better, Pinnacle prices both sides of the same line.

Grade: every Edge play shows a letter grade A..C on line 1 of its row, with the reason in its Why. Player props blend the edge % with a hit-rate model from real recent logs (last 10 + season); game lines and props with no log grade on price, max B+. Thin markets (alts, periods, 3-way) cap at B; fill plays below the bar cap at C+. Grades are display/strength only; ranking stays by edge %.

6-8% STAR: NHL Edge picks with edge >= 0.06 and < 0.08 show a gold star (⭐) and subtle gold highlight and are listed first in the NHL Edge box (rank order kept within each group); NHL picks in Big 4 / Today Edge lists get the star but are not reordered. Results is retroactive: every settled NHL Edge play with 0.06 <= edge < 0.08, dated 2026-10-25 or later and graded Win/Loss, shows the star next to its result, and the Edge results view shows a starred-plays line (W-L, units; 16-10, +19.8u at adoption). Same picks, same counting; selection and records unchanged.

Big-edge assist flag: NHL Edge assist picks (overs or unders, any assist market) with 12%+ model edge (edge >= 0.12) carry a visible warning chip and are logged to a paper-tracked split. This is a FLAG, NOT A GATE: they still post as normal Edge picks and count in Edge and the Official record exactly as before. The split is not a separate record and never changes Official totals. Baseline at adoption: 6-20, -7.15u all-time; 6-17, -4.15u since Oct 25.

BIG-EDGE 12%+ FLAG, WIDENED: every NHL Edge play with edge >= 0.12, all markets, carries 🔺 (one swappable constant BIGSYM in index.html) and a chip "🔺 12%+ edge: W-L, ±Xu since Oct 25" read live. Results show a retroactive 🔺 on settled NHL Edge 12%+ plays since 2026-10-25, with a record line under the ⭐ line. The paper-tracked tile covers all NHL 12%+ with the assist subset kept as a sub-line. One legend at the top of the NHL Edge list explains ⭐ 6-8%, 🔺 12%+ and ⚠ big-edge assist (the ⚠ assist chip stays on 12%+ assist picks; the per-row ⭐ caption is folded into it). No reorder for 🔺, no elimination, no re-pick; plays post and count as normal Edge plays and record keys are unchanged.

🎯 SOG AVG AGREES: an NHL Edge Shots On Goal play gets 🎯 when the player's last-10 SOG average (games strictly before the pick date, NHL api-web game log, exact-name player match) agrees with the side: OVER -> L10 avg >= line; UNDER -> L10 avg <= line. Disagree -> no symbol. Non-SOG markets never get it. the bot logs sog_l10, sog_l10_n and sog_agree on every NHL Edge SOG row. Results: one 🎯 record line since Oct 25 with live-since-Nov 4 under it. One entry in the single NHL Edge legend.

Display: Edge box collapsed shows only its play count until opened. Empty labels: "No Edge plays qualified today" when the slate has games and nothing qualified; "No games today" only when there are no games.
lotto: Lotto Ticket / TD City discontinued (user order 2026-11-09 8:30 AM ET). History archived; no new tickets.
nascar: NASCAR: live race feed sits below Qualifying and loads collapsed. NASCAR/GOLF are non-majors.
grading: Picks are graded once the game is final. Ambiguous stays Pending.
Void = inactive/scratched player or postponed/cancelled game (no carry-over). Never void a POTD for price drift.

Safe pending alert: a Safe +100 ticket still Pending more than 24h after its last game is flagged in the bot and the nightly grade_finals report; grade_finals re-grades Pending Safe dates from the last 7 days.
TD City and First Blood (FIRST BLOOD + TD CITY RECORD): ticket graded as 1u (W/L/VOID); legs graded hit/miss only, no units on legs; a leg whose player doesn't play auto-voids.
Parlay is L as soon as any leg loses. Runners-up removed mid-game are dropped, not graded.
results: Edge = its own section, one result per Edge pick, broken down by prop type.
The Heist = the daily Cappers buy-downs, its own card and record under Official, tallied as individual alt props and graded nightly.
LEG DAY = the daily ranked props board: each board prop is one 1u Official result. Its own compact tile and record under Official, with a per-sport breakdown.

Cappers = every capper pick (idea sources), one result each, tracking only: never in the Official headline. Tracked as 1u singles at the posted odds and shown in the list format. Two different picks on the same player both count, and a ladder counts once.

Record tab: the same groups in the same order (Official, Edge, Cappers), built from the same rows as Results, so both pages always agree. First Blood and TD City / Lotto Ticket each count in Official as one 1u result per ticket at its real posted odds; legs are hit/miss only. TD City keeps its own Results bubble. The First Blood Results bubble is removed; its tickets show only inside Official.
Live plays (Live POTD, Live +100, in-game and live calls) are never tracked on Results or Record.
Count every ticket once. A leg that is the same play as that day's POTD counts once.
Sport filter chips: All, NFL, NHL, MLB, NBA, WNBA, NCAAF, NASCAR. Mixed-sport (Big 4) tickets show under All.

By prop: rare prop types merge into families (Receiving yds, Rushing yds, Receptions, Pass yds, Anytime TD, SOG, Saves, Pitcher Ks, Hits/TB, ML, Spread, Total, Team total, NASCAR finish...), sorted by volume. The top 8 show, the rest sit behind "Show more".

Alt parlay bubble views: the Alt Parlay / Safe +100 bubble supports the same By day / By prop views as Official, so Safe +100 Alt Parlay results are tracked like the rest (by day or by prop type). By prop uses the logged leg results; the ticket still counts once.
Streak dots: Alt Parlay results show the same red/green streak bubbles as Official.
Alt parlay tracking:
Ticket remains the only 1u result.
Each individual alt leg is logged and displayed as hit/miss in a clean list format (player, prop, locked odds, status) inside the Alt Parlay bubble, same visual style as Edge.
Legs do not carry their own units.

Void/push legs: Void or push Alt Parlay legs show on the hit/miss list as VOID (or PUSH) and are excluded from the hit-rate percentage. They still appear in the list. The parent ticket continues to be re-priced on the remaining legs.
Capper original picks tracking:
Tracked as 1u singles at the odds the capper posted.
Displayed in the same list format under the Cappers bubble (player, prop, posted odds, W/L).
Separate from Heist conversions. Stays out of the Official total.

MISSING ODDS = FIND, THEN -125 BASELINE: "If they don't post the odds we find the odds." and "After we look if we cannot find the odds ourselves and they didn't post them only then we will add a -125 baseline to any pick missing odds". When a capper posts no odds, we look up the price ourselves first. Only if the capper posted none AND we can't find one do we price the pick at a -125 baseline. START DATE: "-125 fallback only for picks from Nov 9 on; earlier none-posted rows aren't re-priced with it". Q-ODDS1 closed.
Summary strip: Today / This week / All-time record and units, plus Best streak, Hottest prop and Coldest prop callouts (a prop needs 3+ decisions).
Money bag on hits, color-coded result chips, voided picks read "VOID".
Collapse standard: days and props load collapsed to a one-line summary. A collapsed Rules dropdown sits at the bottom.
The Results data is rebuilt from the ledgers on every data rebuild (never hard-coded).
heist: The Heist is a daily Official parlay built from the cappers' own picks, each moved to a shorter real Hard Rock alt line.

No lineup/injury rules: The Heist is strictly the cappers' plays converted down. Lineup and injury rules do not apply to it: no injury, inactive, matchup or lineup swaps on Heist legs, and "Questionable = out", Swaps, projected lineups, projected starters and replacements do not apply. A leg whose player does not play is settled under Grading below (void or DNP stays Pending until settled by hand).

Exempt from the official standards's edge rule (no Pinnacle edge requirement) and from the parlay shape. Everything else still applies: real Hard Rock prices only, never invent a price, locks, grading.

ALL PLAYS, NOBODY REMOVED: every straight play a Heist-eligible capper (@alexcaruso, @panpotd, @austinsprops, @showtimepicks2, @bigmikepickz) posts that day is a main HEIST leg, in capper order then posting order.
